status: ACTIVE / FAMILY-WIDE / USER-OPERATING-PREFERENCE / CAPITAL-ONLY / NON-PREDICTION / NON-NUMERICAL-PREDICTION

interpretation.target_semantics: 10,000 yen is a race-level ceiling/available budget, not a spending target.
interpretation.unused_budget: MUST_NOT create extra tickets or enlarge semantic width merely to consume unused budget.
interpretation.below_budget: Execute the complete MEC recommendation at its required capital; do not scale to 10,000 yen by default.
interpretation.above_budget: Do not delete material semantics to fit. Route to PAPER by default.
interpretation.point_explosion_guard: The 10,000 yen cap plus 100 yen final ticket unit bounds a minimum-stake portfolio to at most 100 tickets; MEC should normally be far narrower.
interpretation.decimal_rule: Internal stake weights/ratios may use decimals; final purchasable JRA/NAR ticket stakes remain in legal 100-yen increments unless a family-specific rule requires otherwise.
interpretation.explicit_override: A later explicit user instruction for a specific race/day/chat may override this default.
